teaser: A release measured step by step, 123 local builds, 245 CI runs and 1,061 test checks, and where each check actually lives.
core_idea: Measuring the newsroom's checks shows a release takes about 8 minutes locally, half of it a borrowed generator, and about 5 in CI, with the same tests run twice; most CI failures come from tests coupled to live services; failed tests do not stop the deploy; and several checks live only in the session, the container or nowhere, so moving them into the repository and CI is the work.

nodes.label: Tests do not gate the deploy
What to change
nodes.summary: Five jobs, decoupled tests, checks in the repo.

quotes.text: That is the strongest case for change, because a test that fails for reasons outside the code teaches everyone to ignore it.
A check is only as durable as the place it lives
Half the local time is the borrowed generator, which is the cutover not yet finished.
